{{Quote|No krakana!|[[Anakin Solo]], to [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>}}
'''Krakana''' were aquatic creatures that lived on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. They were believed by many to be some of the most dangerous creatures on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A krakana had tentacles tipped with deadly pincers, could swim at high speeds, and had several rows of sharp teeth. They were relatives of the [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] along with [[Cilghal]] encountered krakana when Leia was searching for information about [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] whereabouts.

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and Leia Solo were on vacation to Mon Calamari with their family, Leia told her son, [[Anakin Solo]], not to play in the water because of the krakana. Later, Anakin would use that excuse whenever his siblings told him not to go somewhere by responding "See it's okay, no krakana!"

They were the source of [[krakana filet]] and were the inspiration for [[Foreign Intruder Defense Organism|FIDO]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] defense droid. They were also the namesake for the [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana]], an aquatic vessel used by the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] in the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
